item.title: Minneapolis nurses hold vigil for Alex Pretti after fatal shooting
item.description: A prayer vigil took place Wednesday night at 26th and Nicollet, where nurses gathered to honor Alex Pretti, an ICU nurse who was fatally shot by a Border Patrol agent on Jan. 24. Community gathers in supportThe street was packed with both nurses and non-nurses, all holding candles in memory of Pretti.
